reads.sell: A Left Bank Bordeaux built on Cabernet Sauvignon, with blackcurrant, cedar and graphite over firm, fine tannin and a frame of toasty oak. Decant it and serve it with lamb or a rib of beef.

why.grape: Blackcurrant and cedar over a firm, drying tannic spine, with a graphite and green bell pepper edge, is Cabernet Sauvignon.
why.climate: Black fruit that is ripe but never jammy, a herbal edge, medium plus acidity and alcohol short of high say a moderate maritime climate.

reads.region: Napa Valley, Sonoma County and Paso Robles
reads.sell: A rich California Cabernet Sauvignon, all blackcurrant and black cherry, with mocha, vanilla and toast from new oak over firm, ripe tannin. It is made for a dry aged steak.

why.grape: Cassis and black cherry on a full body with high, drying tannin is Cabernet Sauvignon, here wrapped in new oak.
why.climate: Ripe to jammy black fruit, alcohol at medium plus or high and acidity that has eased towards medium say a warm, sunny climate.
